intro: People, pets, wildlife, boats, buildings and everything in between, drawn in pencil from your photos.
pricing:
Every commission is priced by what you'd like drawn, so there's no price list. Request a commission below about your idea and she'll reply with a quote.

There's no deposit and nothing to pay up front. You only pay once you've seen the finished piece and love it. If it isn't what you hoped for, you don't owe a thing.

A detailed drawing can take 40 to 200 hours. She'll send progress photos along the way if you'd like them.
steps: Send a request with a few good, clear photos.
Cindy replies by email with a quote. Nothing is due yet.
She draws your piece and sends you a photo of the finished artwork.
Love it? Pay in full, or ask about a payment plan; the artwork is yours once it's paid off. Not quite right? You owe nothing.
Pick it up locally or have it shipped anywhere in the U.S.
